reviews.title: Money hungry.
reviews.text: I used to play this game all the time when I was younger. When more of the game was free and fun to play without paying. I installed the game today just to get a bit of nostalgia and see how things are and if anything changed. Yeah, well that nostalgia turned to anger when i found out how much of the game is only playable if you pay. For example, I wanted to check out the backyard and do some gardening when it told me to subscribe. The backyard used to be free, yes you could've payed for some but you could still enjoy the backyard without spending money. Overall I rate this game 1 star. The game isn't fun if you just hang out around the dream house on thr first and second floor. One of my favorite parts of the game when I used to play was going to the shops and gardening in the backyard. I also don't know what happened to the hearts, where your character needed you to do a task and you would get money once you fill up the heart. I miss that and think you guys should at least add that. Anyway, the game would be so much more enjoyable if you added the old things back, especially the patio, heart feature, backyard, THE BEACH, the camp ground, the shops, and etc. I can go on and on. So PLEASE, do us all a big favor. Thank you.
